summary.intent: Create or refresh an Entire checkpoint for a hackathon project, ensuring the commit message trailer and the documentation and evidence files (README, docs/entire, screenshot, hackathon.md) are correct and redacted.
summary.outcome: A new checkpoint (98bc1d77a613) was created. The commit message was corrected to remove the stale trailer from the deleted checkpoint. Redactions were added and the checkpoint was regenerated, with README.md, docs/entire/README.md, hackathon.md and the evidence screenshot modified.

repo: Commit messages can carry a trailer referencing a checkpoint ID. After a checkpoint is deleted and recreated, the old trailer can remain alongside the new one and must be fixed manually.
Checkpoint evidence is stored under docs/evidence/ as entire-checkpoint-<id>.png, and docs/entire/README.md documents the checkpoint. These files need updating when the checkpoint ID changes.
The checkpoint output is scanned for sensitive content. Redactions are added to the checkpoint and it is then regenerated.
workflow: The commit message can be amended without running hooks, so the hooks do not re-trigger checkpoint creation.
After fixing the trailer, scan the correct checkpoint directory (the new ID) rather than the old one.

friction: The new commit message kept the trailer of the deleted checkpoint, which required a manual fix.
The scan had to be re-pointed at the correct checkpoint directory.
Redactions had to be added after the scan, and the checkpoint regenerated, which means extra iterations.
open_items: The evidence screenshot is still named for the older checkpoint (97c75579b386), while the current checkpoint is 98bc1d77a613. The file name and docs references may need to be made consistent.
Confirm that the regenerated checkpoint passes the scan with no remaining sensitive content.
